transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you that brought you in today?

Um… I guess my eating’s been kind of off lately. For the past few weeks I’ll realize I skipped breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then at dinner I just sort of pick at it. Even when my wife made something. My jeans are feeling looser, so… I figured I should mention it.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?
Yeah… most days lately I wake up feeling kind of heavy. Flat, I guess. The apartment feels too quiet, and even picking up my guitar doesn’t really do much for me.
Do you feel this heaviness or low mood throughout the entire day, or does it get a little better at times?

It’s… mostly there through the day, I think. Sometimes it eases a little if I’m distracted, but I usually wake up with that heavy, flat feeling, and it doesn’t really lift much. Even stuff like playing guitar doesn’t do much.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most of the time, even when you haven’t done anything physically demanding?
I’m not sure… I mean, I feel kind of slowed down, but I haven’t really been paying attention to whether it’s tiredness exactly.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately, like waking up too early or not being able to fall asleep, or on the flip side, do you find yourself sleeping much more than usual?
Yeah… I sleep, but it’s not great. I keep waking up around four or five, usually thinking about bills or tracks I haven’t finished. Then I’m already tired before the day really starts.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you once liked?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really thought about it that way. Some things just feel kind of harder to get into, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly or concentrate on tasks lately?
Yeah… a bit. Like if I’m trying to work on some code or arrange a song, I’ll just keep rereading the same line, or replaying the same few bars, and I still can’t really figure out what to do next.
Have you experienced a loss of interest or pleasure in most activities, even ones you used to enjoy?
I mean… not most things, I don’t think. Some stuff just takes more effort lately, but I wouldn’t say I’ve totally lost interest.
Would you say that your low mood is present most of the day, nearly every day, even when nothing specific is bothering you?

Yeah… most days, I think. I kind of wake up with this heavy, flat feeling. Even if nothing happened, the place just feels too quiet, and… I don’t know, even picking up my guitar doesn’t really change it much.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?
I’m not sure… maybe a little, but I don’t think it’s been a big thing. I haven’t really noticed blaming myself more than usual.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your appetite or any unintentional weight loss recently?
Yeah… a bit. I haven’t really been meaning to, but I’ll skip breakfast and lunch sometimes, and then dinner I just kind of pick at. My jeans have been feeling looser lately.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you been more restless or fidgety lately?
Yeah… slower, I guess. Like I’ll have my laptop open and just sit there for a long time before I even start typing or plug in my keyboard. It’s not really fidgety, more like… stuck.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things for weeks at a time?
Yeah… I think so. It’s kind of been on and off for maybe three months, looking back. The last few weeks have been more noticeable.
Before these past few months, have you ever had a period lasting two weeks or more where you felt down or lost interest in most things?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe, but I don’t remember anything clearly lasting that long before this.
